Benchmark tutorials¶

These pages are generated from scripts in benchmarks/. They explain what each benchmark measures, prefer visual summaries for quick reading, and keep JSON/CSV outputs under the generated artifact directory instead of the repository root. For terminology across lattice filters, model reduction, and MIMO systems, see The lattice DSP concept map.

Build the full benchmark tutorial gallery with results:

./scripts/build_docs_with_results.sh
